title: Magemind: castle defense where you type (or speak) any spell. Free demo
author: Alarming_Shape_7144
selftext:
Platform: Windows
    Link: https://poweredie.itch.io/magemind
    Price: free demo (campaign up to the first boss), full game paid
    
    
    Description:
    A pixel-art castle defense where you write your spells instead of picking them from a menu. Type
    "meteor shower on the trolls" or "a thick stone wall at the gate" and your wizard casts exactly that.
    A small classifier built into the game understands it offline. You can also hold V and speak.
    
    
    Elemental reactions, 10 regions, 10 bosses, roguelite runs, Daily Challenge, LAN co-op and duels,
    6 languages.
    
    
    What I'd love feedback on: did the game understand the spells you tried? Tell me the weirdest one you
    typed and what happened.
    
    I would love to know that there are people enjoying my first big game launched

comments.body: u/Alarming_Shape_7144 please expand this post with how you used AI during development. It's not enough to say you used AI. Tell us what you did with it. If you don't update, this may be removed.
